call_points.text: Disbursals targeted at ~₹10,000 Cr in H1FY27, ~₹20,000 Cr in H2FY27 and ₹40,000-50,000 Cr a year by FY28.
Domestic rating targeted at AA+ to AAA by FY28; international rating from BB+ to BBB in H1FY27.
Completed bond buybacks of USD 63 Mn and was the third-highest bond issuer among AA+ peers in Apr-Aug 2026.
Avenir (IHC) stake at 28.5%, to rise to ~43.5% on a ~₹3,198 Cr warrant infusion subject to conversion by 30 Sept 2027.
Retail expansion (digital personal, micro-LAP, rural home loans) is anchored in H2FY27, so cost precedes revenue.

operating_notes.text: Sammaan Capital's USD 450 mn 7.5% Senior Secured Social Bonds due 2030 were tendered beyond the USD 45 mn cap, giving a scaling factor of about 38.147%.
Sammaan Capital was upgraded to CRISIL AA+/Stable on 10 April 2026, which the company says will reduce cost of funds and widen access to longer-tenor funding.

Sammaan Capital completed the tender of U.S.$45,000,000 of its U.S.$450,000,000 7.5% 2030 social bonds at U.S.$1,000 per U.S.$1,000 principal, paying U.S.$45,074,999.97 in total; U.S.$405,000,000 remains outstanding.
CARE upgraded Sammaan Capital's long-term debt two notches to CARE AA+/Stable, reaffirmed CP and short-term NCDs at CARE A1+ and upgraded perpetual debt to CARE AA/Stable from CARE A+.
Crisil Monitoring Agency reports for Q4 FY26 indicate steady utilization across rights issue, QIP, and preferential issue proceeds.
Sammaan Capital officially became part of IHC Group following a USD 1 billion (₹8,850 crore) strategic investment.
S&P Global Ratings upgraded long-term international credit rating to BB- with Stable Outlook.
Q1FY27 disbursals of ₹3,875 Cr across five products to ~12,000 new customers; 97% of disbursals were secured loans.
Blended collection efficiency was 99.6% in Q1FY27, with residential housing at 99.4%.
₹840 Cr of CRE loans were disbursed in partnership with one of Asia's leading alternate credit funds.

timeline.summary: On 21 April 2026, Sammaan Capital said it accepted USD 45 mn of its USD 450 mn 7.5% 2030 social bonds in the tender offer, with a 38.147% scaling factor and settlement expected 24 April 2026.
On April 22, 2026, Sammaan Capital announced the receipt of observation letters with no adverse observations from BSE and no objection from NSE for its proposed demerger scheme.
On April 20, 2026, Sammaan Capital reported that nil shares were tendered in the open offer escrow demat account.
On 24 April 2026, Sammaan Capital certified timely interest payment on public issue NCDs.
On 28 April 2026, Sammaan Capital's ALCO approved buying back five privately placed NCD series at par through the exchange mechanism, with holders able to tender until 15 May 2026.
On 5 May 2026, Sammaan Capital completed its cash tender offer, buying back USD 45 mn of its USD 450 mn 7.5% 2030 social bonds at par for a total USD 45,074,999.97, leaving USD 405 mn outstanding.
Sammaan Capital certified the timely payment of principal and interest on its secured redeemable non-convertible debentures.
Sammaan Capital receives RBI's no-objection for NBFC business transfer scheme
Sammaan Capital submitted the Monitoring Agency reports for its rights issue, QIP, and preferential issue for Q4 FY26.
On 20 May 2026, Sammaan Capital reported its FY26 financial results showing a net loss of ₹7,144.56 Cr and detailed its strategic integration with IHC.
Sammaan Capital reported an FY26 consolidated net loss of ₹7,144.56 Cr and received board approval for an enabling fundraise of up to ₹10,000 Cr.
On May 20, 2026, Sammaan Capital informed the stock exchanges about the audio recording link for its Q4 and FY26 financial results conference call.
Sammaan Capital completed a USD 1 billion strategic investment from IHC Group, bringing in an initial ₹5,652 Cr and achieving credit rating upgrades to AA+/Stable.
Sammaan Capital submitted the post-offer advertisement on May 21, 2026, for the open offer by Avenir Investment and IHC Capital Holding.
Sammaan Capital hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call detailing its strategic integration with IHC and growth roadmap.
Sammaan Capital Limited scheduled a physical B&K conference with one-on-one and group meetings on May 29, 2026, per SEBI Listing Regulations.
Sammaan Capital certified timely payment of interest and principal on public issue NCDs on May 29, 2026.
15 Aug 2026: Sammaan Capital re-uploaded its Q1FY27 earnings update with balance sheet numbers, showing PAT of ₹243 Cr, AUM of ₹56,239 Cr and a 20.1% capital adequacy ratio.
Sammaan Capital made a timely interest payment of ₹8.29 Cr on its secured redeemable non-convertible debentures (ISIN INE148I07UX9).
Sammaan Capital allotted 8.69 Cr equity shares to promoter Avenir Investment upon conversion of warrants, raising promoter stake to 33.32% and raising ₹906 Cr.
